quest.title: The Price
quest.description: You notice two strange individuals in Port Ormos...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: ...Did you close that deal?

dialogues.speaker: Alexandra
dialogues.text: The old cargo ship has just been unloaded. Don't worry.

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: The ship didn't leak, right? And about <color=#00E1FFFF>the cargo...</color> All hidden?

dialogues.speaker: Alexandra
dialogues.text: Yes, all hidden somewhere safe and secret.

dialogues.speaker: Alexandra
dialogues.text: But... what about the old stuff that have been replaced?

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: Just throw them away. With the new cargo in hand, the old stuff is of no use.

dialogues.speaker: Alexandra
dialogues.text: I—Is that okay?

talks.objective: Talk to Paimon after getting the mysterious item

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! The box is open! It's surprisingly easy.

choices.text: Let me see...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm, anyway... Let's see what it has first.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like... there're only some worn clothes and a stack of letters.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It says...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "To the south of Devantaka Mountain, the old ship leaves port."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What does that mean? How can there be a ship in the mountain?

choices.text: Maybe it's some kind of code...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... we'll just have to figure it out.

choices.text: The Fatui must be plotting something.
The box could have something to do with those two Fatui...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The south of Devantaka Mountain... That's a huge area.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The view is good here. Let's wait and see if there's anyone coming.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You wait here with Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look... Somebody's coming this way!

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: Why are you so late? Did you run into any trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Alexandra
dialogues.text: ...Sorry, someone must have opened the box. I'm afraid our plan...

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: Tsk, did we get caught? But... it's not like the higher-ups have sent anyone here lately...

dialogues.speaker: Alexandra
dialogues.text: Maybe... Maybe it was Nika? Those kids have been badgering me to take them out to play...

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: *sigh*... That's why I told you not to get too close to those folks, unless necessary.

dialogues.speaker: Alexandra
dialogues.text: But their parents are always away from home, I just...

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: Forget it. Either way, we're leaving here today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Leaving? Do they mean... leaving Sumeru?

dialogues.speaker: Alexandra
dialogues.text: We don't have any helpers. Can the plan... work? I mean, what if the higher-ups found out about us...

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: Stop worrying... Haven't you had enough yet?

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: Living in fear, never to be trusted for a single second...

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: Today is our last chance to get away from the Fatui!

dialogues.speaker: Alexandra
dialogues.text: I—I know, but...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These two... want to leave the Fatui?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay. But be careful. They are the Fatui after all!

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: Hehe, someone has shown up after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You found me?

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: You've been eavesdropping for a while without moving.

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: As the wind blew just now, the bush you were hiding in swayed differently from the one next to it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y—You Fatui really are something...

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: #{M#Blond}{F#Blonde} hair... and a strange Seelie. You must be the "Traveler" mentioned in the report.

choices.text: That's right.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Since you're here, I assume you have checked the stuff in the box.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: I'm surprised that Alexandra's trick actually worked.

choices.text: What do you want?

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: As you heard, Alexandra and I want to get away from the Fatui.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Stop looking at me like that. For your information, we're neither higher-ups in power nor front-line soldiers.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: We are at best some pawns left in a random place waiting to be deployed.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: There are plenty of people like us, but... most of them won't get any orders all their lives.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Being a Fatuus, one could only spend the rest of their life in the distrust from others.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: We don't want to end up like that. Instead of wasting life here, we'd rather take the risk and free ourselves from the Fatui.

response.speaker: Alexandra
response.text: But getting away is far from easy. If we get caught, there will be... serious consequences.

response.speaker: Alexandra
response.text: So we thought up a plan to fake death in an attempt to escape.

response.speaker: Alexandra
response.text: But our "death" must be proved by someone who is convincing.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Traveler, you are such a notorious figure for the Fatui, and... Hehe, you've always been at odds with the Fatui.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: You are the ideal witness to the death of two Fatui.

choices.text: What made you so sure that I would come here?

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: I wasn't sure whether you would come, but I would wait until you come.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Patience is one of the few strengths I have.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Traveler, now that we've told you the whole story, it's your choice if you want to help.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: If your answer is yes, we'll give you a handsome amount of rewards in return.

response.speaker: Alexandra
response.text: And don't worry, the money is earned by doing serious work. I can assure you!

response.speaker: Alexandra
response.text: I... I cooked dinner for those kids, sewed clothes, told stories, and took them out...

response.speaker: Alexandra
response.text: And Przheva helped others with hunting and handling prey...

response.speaker: Alexandra
response.text: If we manage to leave the Fatui, we will make a living out of these skills! And...

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Enough, Alexandra! That's too much information!

response.speaker: Alexandra
response.text: Oh... right! Okay...

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Anyway, it's all up to you, Traveler.

choices.text: I'll help.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Thank you, Traveler. You will get rich rewards.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Then it's a deal. Now let's go separate ways and get ready.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Alexandra, you go take care of that.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: And Traveler, please follow me.

choices.text: Aren't you afraid I'd back out?

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Then we'll fight as hard as we can, and in the end... die at your hands.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: It sounds much like our original plan, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You'd better have enough money.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Of course, it'll be a very generous amount.

choices.text: What if I hadn't come here today...

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Then we would go back and suspend the plan until you come.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: We've been planning this for so long. It wouldn't hurt to wait a bit longer.

choices.text: So you said all those things just for me to hear?
Did you set this trap for me?

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Relax. We wouldn't have had time for that.

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: This is the place, Traveler. Listen, it's a simple plan.

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: We are two... ahem, evil Fatui coming over to this forest for some evildoing.

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: And you, out of indignation or righteousness, try to stop us.

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: Just as Alexandra and I are about to run, a group of monsters appears and strikes us down.

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: Being outnumbered by the monsters, you have no choice but to pull back. When you are back with helpers, Alexandra and I are already gone.

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: That's the plan. What do you think?

choices.text: Well crafted, I have to say.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: For the story to make sense and our failure to seem more natural, I've put a lot of thought into it.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: But why hasn't Alexandra returned by now? Just setting up some lures for monsters doesn't take that long.
Alexandra! Alexandra! *sob*...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, Paimon heard someone over there!

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Shoot! Alexandra must be in trouble!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Wait! Where are you going!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's follow!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What happened...

choices.text: Just sounds like how the Fatui would end up.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Right. The pawns in the Fatui out there collecting intel normally end up like this.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: We made this plan just because we don't want to be one of them.

dialogues.speaker: Alexandra
dialogues.text: Sorry... ahem... Przheva...

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: Don't talk. I'll patch you up.

dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: *sobbing*... I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you here?

dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: I'm... I'm here to pick mushrooms... *sob*...

dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: Alexandra... looks so sad these days...

dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: So we talked about cooking something great to surprise her.

dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: Alexandra once took us here and picked all those delicious mushrooms, and I thought I'd pick some myself.

dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: B—But I got lost in the woods, and before I knew it, I was surrounded by so many mushrooms.

dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: To save me, Alexandra... Alexandra... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Alexandra
dialogues.text: *cough*... It's... It's okay, Nika... I'm fine...

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: ...Looks like there's a change of the plan.

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: Alexandra sustained serious injuries, and other Fatui must have noticed that we left the town without permission. If I take her back now, we will only get arrested for inspection.

choices.text: Then what about your plan...

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Hehe... Just go along with it and see what will happen.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: I happened to see a group of the Eremites heading this way on my way here.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Traveler, you send the kid off the forest to the Eremites. I will take Alexandra and leave.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Remember our plan? Looks like now we have to do it for real.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: The Eremites must think that two evil Fatui are doing something evil here, and that saving Nika is just a cover-up.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: If we come under attack by the monsters... well, it serves us right.

response.speaker: Nika
response.text: *sob*... Alexandra... I will never make any trouble again...

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: ...Good thing this kid didn't have the mood to listen to what we just said. No need to worry about him.

choices.text: But what you did was for saving the kid...

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Trust me, few would believe in "the Fatui's heroic sacrifice."

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: "The evil Fatui eating their own bitter fruit" is much more acceptable.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Remember the place where you eavesdropped on Alexandra and me for the first time? If... we manage to get away, I will leave a letter there.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you knew from the beginning...

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: With only one chance, we have to be careful.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We should save Alexandra first!

response.speaker: Alexandra
response.text: I'm fine, Traveler... Ahem... I can take it...

response.speaker: Alexandra
response.text: ...But if we miss this chance to get out of the Fatui, I'd rather... ahem, *coughing*!!

response.speaker: Nika
response.text: Alexandra, where are you going? Please come back with us! Everyone is looking for you!

response.speaker: Alexandra
response.text: Listen, Nika... The Traveler will take you back... ahem...

response.speaker: Alexandra
response.text: I'm... gonna take a rest here. I will be back if I'm feeling any better...

response.speaker: Nika
response.text: B—But...

response.speaker: Alexandra
response.text: When did I ever lie to you? Ahem... Just be a good boy, will you?

response.speaker: Nika
response.text: *whimper*... Okay...

response.speaker: Alexandra
response.text: Traveler, please take good care of him...

choices.text: I'll be right back.

response.speaker: Przheva
response.text: Thank you, Traveler.

choices.text: Leave it to me.
But you are not evil...
Then what do you do now?

dialogues.speaker: Berat
dialogues.text: I didn't know this errand could take that long... how exhausting...

dialogues.speaker: Berat
dialogues.text: Wait! Who's there!

dialogues.speaker: Berat
dialogues.text: Nika... and Traveler, what are you doing here?

choices.text: Please take care of Nika!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—We are running out of time! Please watch Nika for a while!

response.speaker: Berat
response.text: What? What did you mean? Wait a moment!

choices.text: Someone's under attack over there!

talks.objective: Go back and check on Alexandra

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alexandra should be around here. Where... Where are they?

choices.text: Alexandra!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Where are you!

response.speaker: Berat
response.text: Stop shouting! You will only attract the monsters!

response.speaker: Berat
response.text: Nika told me the whole story. I'm so surprised that Alexandra and Przheva are Fatui members.

response.speaker: Berat
response.text: I thought they were good folks when dealing with them...

response.speaker: Nika
response.text: Alexandra is a good person! Przheva is tough... but also a good person!

response.speaker: Berat
response.text: Umm, but they are Fatui! Who knows if they are just acting nice but actually with ulterior motives?

response.speaker: Berat
response.text: I mean, I've heard plenty of shady deals of the Fatui.

response.speaker: Berat
response.text: Maybe they were just scheming something and using saving Nika as a cover-up?

choices.text: They...

response.speaker: Berat
response.text: You don't know about that. And it's not like we can find them...

response.speaker: Berat
response.text: One of them is wounded... so according to my experience, the monsters must have... well...

response.speaker: Nika
response.text: Berat! Could you keep looking? Please!!

response.speaker: Berat
response.text: Nika, if I wasn't here alone, I promise I would search the whole forest out.

response.speaker: Berat
response.text: But there's only me here. The monsters are one thing, and what if there're other Fatui here...

response.speaker: Berat
response.text: Ahem, anyway... Traveler, I say we go back to the city first. I'll report this to my superior and follow his order.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Berat takes Nika and leaves...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: His response is just as Przheva expected...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But did they... manage to get away?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's not much we can do now. Let's head back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Przheva said if they managed to leave, they would leave a letter at the place where they were.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go take a look if we have time.

choices.text: They... are not bad...
Przheva!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There're some... worn clothes and a stack of letters.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What does the letter say?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon see...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It says "To the south of Devantaka Mountain, the old ship leaves port."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What does that mean? How can there be a ship in the mountain?

choices.text: Maybe it's the clue to some treasures.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And we don't know who left the box here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, let's go take a look!

choices.text: Maybe it leads to a treasure trove.

dialogues.speaker: Berat
dialogues.text: Stop crying, Nika. What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: *sob*... Alexandra...

dialogues.speaker: Berat
dialogues.text: Alexandra? What's she doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Berat
dialogues.text: Nika, tell me what happened in detail...

dialogues.speaker: Alexandra
dialogues.text: Ahem... Sorry, Przheva, I'm not cut out for this job...

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: Don't say that.
